function.description: Swap one SPL token for another on SOLANA via the Jupiter aggregator. Simulated and asserted before anything is broadcast. There is NO allowance to grant or revoke on Solana — Jupiter needs none — so this is a single verb, not the EVM approve/swap/revoke cycle. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_solana_swap

TradePlan.description: 086 W6: the plan an entry states before it quotes (072 D8).

invalidation.description: What, if seen, proves the thesis wrong.
invalidation.title: Invalidation

preset.description: The mandate preset this entry follows (memecoin | majors).
preset.title: Preset

thesis.description: Why this token, now — one or two sentences.
thesis.title: Thesis

TradePlan.title: TradePlan

amount_in.description: Human amount of token_in to sell

close_reason.description: SELL only: why this closes the position — stop_loss | take_profit | trailing | time_stop | owner | retired | dust | orphan | manual | breaker:<name>. Leave empty on a buy.

dry_run.description: TRUE (default) simulates and asserts without broadcasting.

max_spend_usd.description: Your declared ceiling for this swap in USD. The guard holds you to it.

minimum_output_raw.description: Minimum raw output confirmed by the owner; every new route must preserve this floor.

plan.description: Your entry plan {thesis, confidence, invalidation, preset}. REQUIRED for a buy inside a trading-mandate run (refused without it); the exit runs follow it. Omit on a sell.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage bound in basis points. Jupiter bakes its own minimum into the transaction it builds, so this is a bar that minimum must CLEAR — a looser route is refused, not rewritten.

token_in.description: MINT ADDRESS of the token to sell (base58)

token_out.description: MINT ADDRESS of the token to buy (base58)
